svg.title: Sequence: the local runtime's source for every listed agent subscribes to the origin on its own, after its cursor with a cap, or with a tail when it holds no block; the origin answers a delta or Reset plus a fresh tail, then CaughtUp, and absorb keeps the replica one contiguous current block. A client subscribes to its local runtime with a tail count and is answered at once from the block: Snapshot, the newest N rows, then every event the source broadcasts, in order. Scrolling back is a Fetch by order that extends the block downward. Host away: Detached after the held rows, send disabled; a Reset with a chat open is swapped in at the CaughtUp that follows.
svg.text: client (Session)
local runtime
origin daemon
source, for every listed agent while the host is reachable:
SubscribeSession(after: cursor, cap: K) · or tail: K with no block
delta · CaughtUp | Reset · tail K · CaughtUp
absorb: a delta extends the block, Reset replaces it;
cursor = last revision delivered; events broadcast in order
SubscribeSession(agent, tail: N ≤ K)
Snapshot · newest N rows (broadcast joined first)
first render from the cached block; header from the entry;
draft any time; send enabled only while caught_up
live, as broadcast: Item · Append · Snapshot · markers
ListItems(before: oldest order, page_size)
below the boundary → Fetch the origin
page + exhausted → absorb: extends the block downward only
page + exhausted
host away: the source ends and Detached follows the held rows; caught_up = false and the rows stay.
on return the source resumes after its cursor; the delta or a Reset arrives, then CaughtUp again.
reset with a chat open: the client keeps the stale rows on screen and swaps the transcript in at the CaughtUp after the fresh tail.
the overlap between the store read and the broadcast is deduped by key at the client; nothing is filtered by revision.
